title: Pink Self-Care Sunday: The Night Routine
intro: The night routine is the one part of the week nobody can cancel. Puffy slippers at the door, the feather-trim pajama set, the robe over it while the heatless rod does the curls, the satin sleep mask on the nightstand and a cream hooded blanket for the sofa first. Six pieces, all soft, one of them not pink so the pink reads as a choice. It sells in every month that has a Sunday in it.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay on white linen of puffy pink slippers, a pink feather-trim pajama set, a pink satin sleep mask, a pink heatless curling rod set, a pink feather robe and a cream hooded blanket.
Woman in a pink feather-trim robe over pink pajamas and puffy pink slippers on a farmhouse porch at dusk, a heatless curling rod in her hair, a cream blanket on the rocking chair, holding a pink cup.
